material_systems.name: Chalk-Binding Primer for Chalking Foundation
material_systems.description: Low-viscosity chalk-binding conditioner primer that penetrates and binds loose chalk residue on previously painted foundation surfaces. MANDATORY for SS_EXT_CHALKING regardless of quality tier. Full surface application required.

products.notes: MANDATORY for chalking foundation. Full surface application. Penetrates and binds residual chalk layer.

material_systems.notes: RP-SPECIFIC primer. Same product family as masonry wall chalk-binding primer. Coverage rate adjusted for foundation — typically smoother surface than masonry wall.

material_systems.name: Acrylic Stain-Block Primer for Foundation Repaint
material_systems.description: 100% acrylic exterior stain-blocking primer for previously painted foundation surfaces where existing coating has failed or peeled. Applied over intact painted areas surrounding bare spots. Spot prime when localized failure; full prime on SS_EXT_PEELING.

example_products: Benjamin Moore Ultra Spec EXT Primer
products.notes: Stain-blocking adhesion primer for previously painted foundation. Applied over intact painted areas. Bare foundation spots get alkali-resistant primer instead.

prime_scope_by_state.SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT: spot prime feathered areas and surrounding paint
prime_scope_by_state.SS_EXT_PEELING: full surface prime after heavy scrape/wash to sound substrate

material_systems.name: Alkali-Resistant Foundation Primer (Reuse NC)
material_systems.description: Alkali-resistant acrylic primer for exposed bare foundation areas where coating has failed or peeled, revealing cementitious substrate at pH 12-14. MANDATORY on all exposed bare areas. In RP context, applied as spot primer on exposed bare areas.

example_products: Benjamin Moore Ultra Spec Masonry & Stucco Primer
products.notes: MANDATORY on exposed bare foundation (pH 12-14). Spot prime in RP. Same product as NC.

prime_scope_by_state.SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT: spot prime exposed bare foundation at failure points
prime_scope_by_state.SS_EXT_PEELING: spot prime all exposed bare areas; full prime if extensive

material_systems.notes: Reuse NC system unchanged. Chemistry is substrate-driven — same alkalinity in RP.

material_systems.name: Standard Exterior Acrylic Foundation Coating (Reuse NC)
material_systems.description: 100% acrylic exterior masonry paint for foundation. UV-resistant. 10-20 perms breathability. QT2 single coat, QT3 two coats on primed surface.

example_products: Benjamin Moore Ultra Spec EXT Acrylic
products.notes: Reuse NC finish system. Same product on previously primed/painted surface.

material_systems.name: Cementitious Coating for Foundation (Drylok-type) (Reuse NC)
material_systems.description: Cementitious/crystalline coating (Drylok-type). Fills pores, breathable, matte finish only. Withstands 15 PSI hydrostatic pressure. QT2 single coat, QT3 two coats.

products.notes: Reuse NC finish system. Thicker application, lower coverage rate.

coverage_profiles.notes: Chalk-binding primer on previously painted foundation. Higher consumption than standard primer — penetrating into chalk layer. Foundation is typically smoother than masonry wall — slightly higher coverage than masonry wall chalk primer.
Acrylic stain-block primer on previously painted foundation. Standard exterior primer coverage.
Reuse NC coverage. Alkali-resistant primer on bare foundation (pH 12-14). Lower coverage due to substrate absorption.
Reuse NC coverage. Acrylic on primed foundation. Second coat is higher coverage (sealed surface).
Reuse NC coverage. Cementitious coating is thicker — lower coverage rate.

consumables.notes: Standard roller frame for foundation coating.
